rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=12, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=16, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.0001, unet_c=16, outer_wall_s=1500, seed=42, rationale=iter-5: ONE knob pretrain_epochs 6->12 (push the warm-start INIT lever further), keep lr=1e-4 (the iter-3 anchor) and n_iter=300. Failure mode/insight: per-scan U-Net N2I overfits its own GT-free split-view objective, so n_iter is NOT the lever (iter-2 n_iter600 DROPPED 0.9553->0.9407) and per-scan lr is already fully anchored at 1e-4 (iter-3 0.9553->0.9593). The remaining live lever is warm-start INIT QUALITY: iter-4 pretrain_epochs 3->6 lifted 0.9593->0.9596 (small but POSITIVE, not yet saturated), and the demo n2i sibling kept climbing on this exact lever 6->12 (0.4957->0.5081). Hypothesis: a better-converged 12-epoch warm-start init gives each per-scan fit (pinned at lr=1e-4) a stronger anchor, lifting val above 0.9596 toward/over the 128-view LD-FBP baseline. Wall: iter-4 (ep6) ran 468s; doubling pretrain to ep12 adds ~4-5 min, stays well under the 900s/15min wall.
